wide_columns.id: Stable row ID. External display ranks are independent between all and short views.
wide_columns.prompt: Exact source user prompt where available. Unverified external text may be shown, but its prompt group remains isolated.
wide_columns.answer_cells: A single plain string answer or null; no arrays, no concatenation. Existing canonical answer text is preserved exactly.

grouping: Only byte-exact, nonempty, verified user prompt text is grouped across occurrences. Different contexts, images, temperatures, providers and system instructions may still share a user prompt. Display row ranks never imply matched runs or equivalent full contexts.
repeated_answers: Distinct response IDs per prompt/model are sorted by response_id and assigned rank starting at zero. Repeated source occurrences of the same response stay in provenance. Short view reranks independently.
external_cell_metadata.parquet: One record per occupied cell and view. Join on view,id,model. response_id links canonical response metadata; cell_id links occurrence provenance.
external_row_metadata.parquet: One record per row and view: prompt_group_id,prompt_exact,replicate_index,model_count.
external_cell_provenance.parquet: Every external provenance occurrence, unchanged metadata plus occurrence_id,prompt_group_id,grouping_is_exact_user_prompt,row_id_all,cell_id_all,row_id_short,cell_id_short. Short IDs are null for excluded responses.
external_response_metadata.parquet: Canonical response-level metadata from the input, excluding only answer text. Some fields describe its canonical occurrence; occurrence-specific evidence is in external_cell_provenance.
quarantine_luna: Separate author-asserted model corpus. Last transcript item may be tool output, not a standalone user prompt; every occurrence is isolated. Not merged into the main external views. Parquet only: three prompt strings contain embedded NUL bytes, preserved losslessly.
short_filter: Uses the already-curated short_answer_candidate flag, including length 40–250 whitespace words and existing mechanical quality flags. It is not a license or semantic-quality guarantee.
splitting: For model evaluation group by prompt_group_id, not row id; also prevent identical response_id and related trajectories from crossing train/validation folds.
nulls: Parquet preserves nulls and literal strings such as NA. A null model cell means no answer is available.
distribution_scope: External responses and separate Luna quarantine only. Competition train, test, sample submission, original wide tables and original cell metadata are not distributed.
